name: Park Sun-mi
bio:
Park Sun-mi's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination with aerodynamics, fueled by building model airplanes and a natural aptitude for physics. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Seoul National University, she specialized in fluid dynamics and secured a position at a Korean aerospace firm, where she honed her skills in wind tunnel testing. Her yearning for the high-stakes environment of racing led her to Europe, where she initially worked as a junior technician before steadily climbing the ranks. Her keen eye for detail and ability to interpret complex data have made her an invaluable asset. 

At Boutsen VDS, Sun-mi meticulously analyzes airflow patterns, identifying subtle aerodynamic improvements to enhance vehicle performance. She's known for her methodical approach, often spending hours poring over simulations and experimental results to uncover hidden advantages. Her colleagues appreciate her dedication and innovative ideas, which have contributed to several crucial gains in downforce and drag reduction. Sun-mi's goal is to push the limits of aerodynamic efficiency and contribute to a world championship-winning car.
